GENERAL SCIENCE — PREMIUM REVISION PAPER #6
====

GRADE: Grade 12
SUBJECT: GENERAL SCIENCE
TIME ALLOWED: 2 hours 30 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 100
EXAM BODY: KNEC / KCSE pathway

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Polymers? (1 mark)
   A. Guess results without recording observations on Polymers.
   B. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Polymers.
   C. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Polymers.
   D. Skip labelling diagrams related to Polymers.

5. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Electrostatics 3.2 Current Electricity 3.3 Mains Electricity 3.4 Projectile Moti? (1 mark)
   A. Skip labelling diagrams related to Electrostatics 3.2 Current Electricity 3.3 Mains Electricity 3.4 Projectile Moti.

   D. Guess results without recording observations on Electrostatics 3.2 Current Electricity 3.3 Mains Electricity 3.4 Projectile Moti.

6. In a food chain, green plants are usually: (1 mark)
   A. Primary consumers only
   B. Decomposers only
   C. Tertiary consumers
   D. Producers

8. A compound differs from a mixture because: (1 mark)
   A. A mixture always has a fixed melting point
   B. Elements in a compound are chemically combined in a fixed ratio
   C. Mixtures cannot exist in Kenya
   D. A compound can be separated by filtering only

9. The SI unit of force is the: (1 mark)
   A. joule (J)
   B. pascal (Pa)
   C. newton (N)
   D. watt (W)

10. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Carbon and its Oxides? (1 mark)

   B. Guess results without recording observations on Carbon and its Oxides.
   C. Skip labelling diagrams related to Carbon and its Oxides.

11. An element is: (1 mark)
   A. A mixture of two liquids
   B. Any substance that conducts electricity
   C. A pure substance that cannot be broken down into a simpler substance by chemical means
   D. Any white crystal used in cooking

12. Boiling point of pure water at standard pressure is about: (1 mark)
   A. 37 °C
   B. 0 °C
   C. 50 °C
   D. 100 °C

13. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Electrostatics? (1 mark)

   B. Net movement of particles from high to low concentration
   C. Heating until a solid melts
   D. A chemical reaction forming ash

15. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Evolution and Biodiversity? (1 mark)

16. Why is water unsuitable for a petrol fire? (1 mark)
   A. Water removes heat too quickly
   B. Petrol fires have no fuel
   C. Water always increases oxygen
   D. Water can spread burning petrol instead of putting it out safely

17. Photosynthesis mainly produces: (1 mark)
   A. Only carbon dioxide
   B. Only water vapour
   C. Glucose and oxygen
   D. Nitrogen gas only

18. Which practice best shows correct science when studying The Ecosystems? (1 mark)

   A. Paper burning to ash
   B. Ice melting to water
   C. Milk souring
   D. Iron rusting
